description: Land Title Settlement Department - Kawudupitiya, Doluwa D/S Division, Kandy District - Cad. Map No. 320018
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act, No. 21 of 1998. It contains declarations of determination by the Commissioner of Title Settlement regarding specific land parcels, including detailed schedules with parcel numbers, extent measurements, owner names and addresses, and title classifications. The content focuses entirely on land ownership and property rights, falling squarely within the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
